{{Quote|Trynn offered Udeon generous surrender terms, but the latter refused them by shooting the courier.|[[Imperial HoloVision]]|<ref name="GNN3" />}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a '''courier''' was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] sent to quell an [[Uprising on Gerrard V|uprising]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gerrard V]]. After forcing the [[Gerrard V Rebels|rebels]] back to the [[capitol building]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Harazod]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial force, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jion Trynn]] sent the courier with terms of surrender to the rebel commander, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Camon Udeon]]. Udeon refused the terms, punctuating his decision by [[Death/Legends|shooting]] the courier.
